name: Reduction Harness
body:
Price 6,000 gp; Aura moderate transmutation; CL 5th; Slot chest; Weight 10 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

Made of intricately woven copper and silver depicting a mighty beast being reduced to a small cub, this harness can only be worn by a drake with a charge or an animal companion. Upon being activated with a command word, the wearer’s size is reduced to Tiny, remaining so indefinitely until the command word is spoken again.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 3,000 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells reduce person
